title: Teaching Ministry of the Church
definition: The Teaching Ministry of the Church is the faithful instruction of believers in sound doctrine, Scripture, obedience, and discipleship.
summary: The Teaching Ministry of the Church is the ongoing instruction that grounds believers in sound doctrine and trains them to obey Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the Teacher and Lord whose Word forms His disciples through the ministry of the Church.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine differs from preaching by emphasizing the patient, repeated formation of disciples through instruction. Teaching explains, organizes, applies, corrects, and hands down the faith once delivered to the saints. It equips believers to discern error, understand Scripture, and teach others faithfully.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because zeal without teaching becomes unstable. The Church must not only gather a crowd but form disciples who know what they believe and why. Teaching ministry protects the next generation from confusion and strengthens mature obedience.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek instruction, not merely inspiration. Support Bible classes, discipleship, catechesis, mentoring, and faithful training in the church. Ask what truths you are responsible to pass on to someone else.
